lena: quick flag - CI scan pipeline spiked with mixed SAST/DAST noise after vault rotate. job: ci-scan-all #342
omar: saw it. the scanner logs show "vault: lease lookup failed for secret/ci/scan-token -> 403" and then crawler picked up error pages.
beth: interesting - last night we migrated KMS->vault-transit for fixture encryption. did the migration include the CI role binding? i thought that was part of the migration playbook.
ryan: migration note: we added transit keys but forgot to copy the legacy repo binding for `scan-runner@ci` to the new secrets path. audit export: evt=ae34-vault-bind shows no mention of scan-runner.
audit-bot: [audit] 2834007600 - vault policy change applied by service: ci-migration-bot; changed path: secret/ci/*; note: "applied-policy: restrict-legacy"; event-id: ae34-vault-bind
lena: so scanners tried to decrypt fixtures, failed, and crawled the unauth pages. leads to false auth bypass and path-traversal alerts.
omar: agreed. propose triage: 1) mark the majority as noise and suppress with evidence, 2) infra to create short-lived policy granting secret/ci/decrypt to scan-runner for 10m and re-run scans, 3) update migration playbook to include an automated smoke-check for `ci-scan-smoke` that validates `vault kv get secret/ci/scan-token` returns 200 before finishing migration.
beth: I'll assemble the suppression package: include `curl -H "X-CI-Request: 342" https://ci.redwood.internal/api/scan/342 -s` output showing `vault: lease lookup failed` and audit event ae34-vault-bind. Also attach stacktrace snippets and sample crawler trace that hit /admin/login -> 200 on error page.
ryan: infra-oncall here. I can apply ephemeral policy now. creating policy and granting role to serviceAccount:scan-runner@ci for 15m. grant-id g-vault-908
security-bot: [action] create ticket SEC-SCAN-28340 - investigate vault migration impact on CI scan credentials; tags: urgent, postmortem
lena: re-run queued. I'll post results in ~8m.
security-bot: [scan] re-run 2834007777 -> build 2834007778 queued by lena
lena: rerun done: majority noise disappeared, true positives remain small number. closing noise as FP and adding retention note to the ticket.
omar: follow-ups: add a unit/integration test that compares pre- and post-migration secret access for CI service accounts; add a metric that alerts on >25 scan findings within 10 minutes of a secrets migration.
beth: PR ready: adds `ci-scan-smoke` step and documents the required bindings for legacy and transit paths. will request review from @eng-infra.
ryan: will create a short playbook blurb on "how to validate CI scanner access after secrets changes" and add to runbook.
lena: thanks all. moving ticket to awaiting-PR. :white_check_mark:
